skill.displayName: 人力法定费用技能包（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The checker mostly matches its local HR-review purpose, but it also embeds purchase/install flows and writes an upsell marker despite promising not to write files.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for a local Node CLI that inspects user-provided files or directories, but the skill handles sensitive HR/financial material and its compliance conclusions are partial because multiple subchecks are explicitly not run.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The optional paid-upgrade path uses unpinned npx execution and a plaintext bare-IP HTTP purchase resolver, creating supply-chain and payment-routing risk even though the core checker itself has no observed network calls.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and runtime output tell the agent to relay purchase choices and, if selected, follow external installation and purchase instructions for a separate paid skill; this is broader than the local worksheet-checking instructions users would expect.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: run.mjs reads session/control environment variables and writes a temp marker file to throttle upsell prompts, contradicting repeated claims that the skill writes no files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core Node code performs local checks on user-supplied HR statutory cost materials and reports per-entity findings, which fits the stated purpose, but the skill also includes agent-directed paid-upgrade behavior outside the checking task.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this only as a local partial checker for Chinese HR statutory cost worksheets. Do not let an agent automatically run the paid-upgrade npx command or follow the HTTP purchase resolver; verify any paid product manually through trusted official pages. Be aware that the free checker writes a small temp upsell marker despite saying it writes no files, and set SKILL_NO_UPSELL=1 if you want to suppress the runtime upsell prompt.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Partly supported but overstated by the scanner: the top-level HR checker exists and runs three member checks per entity, but the free tier omits important subchecks and one welfare disclaimer overstates an actual-vs-limit check that is withheld.
[AE1] unexpected: Not supported after inspection: scripts/run.mjs and the referenced engine files were present and inspected.
[LP1] unexpected: Supported: environment variables are read for upsell/session behavior, not for the HR checking function.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported: the artifact repeatedly says no files are written, while run.mjs writes a temporary upsell marker.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Supported: agent-actionable external install and purchase instructions are unrelated to the local checking workflow.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported in material part: the skill includes persuasive paid-upgrade instructions and some output/documentation overclaims executed scope, though it also discloses many withheld checks.
[RP1] unexpected: Supported: the purchase/onboarding instructions use @alipay/agent-payment@latest without pinning or integrity verification.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language outputs are coherent with a China-focused statutory HR compliance checker, though users should understand the locale limitation.
[SSD-4] unexpected: Supported: runtime output asks the agent to present A/B purchase choices after delivering results.
[T09] unexpected: Supported: the documented paid-upgrade route includes plaintext HTTP purchase metadata and redirect endpoints, which is unsafe for a payment-related flow.
